text.tspan: From handoff to a reviewed close
An implementing session submits work for review; an independent session approves and closes it. Shows where the state machine, review policy and logged write path each get a say.
td review moves the issue to in_review and makes sure a handoff exists.
DefaultMachine is liberal: the transition table is checked,

td approve checks the transition table, decides eligibility from session history, then records the review and the close in one logged transaction.
